question: Why does Firefox IOUtils MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) of sessionCheckpoints.json.tmp onto sessionCheckpoints.json return NS_ERROR_FILE_ALREADY_EXISTS (STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_COLLISION) when the .tmp write succeeded?

allowedInputs.note: NtfsClearRenameTarget returns STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_COLLISION when ReplaceIfExists is FALSE; NtfsCommitRename / btree insert can also return COLLISION if the index still holds the name after Clear.
vfatPrepareTargetForRename / rename path reads RenameInfo->ReplaceIfExists from the FileRenameInformation buffer.
Duplicate index key insert returns STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_COLLISION.
Browser Console: Move overwrite with temporary file; could not move sessionCheckpoints.json.tmp to sessionCheckpoints.json (NS_ERROR_FILE_ALREADY_EXISTS); .tmp can be written.
